health_human_impact.description: Build technology that improves everyday human life. This track focuses on health, mental wellbeing, accessibility, and productivity. The strongest projects are simple, practical, and immediately useful, designed for students, families, and communities to start using right away.
health_human_impact.challenge: How can you use technology to reduce stress, improve wellbeing, or make daily life easier for real people? Focus on building something accessible, practical, and impactful within the time constraints of the hackathon.
whatGoodLooksLike: Solves a real and relatable human problem
Simple, intuitive, and accessible user experience
Clear and immediate value to the user
Realistic to use beyond the hackathon
Thoughtful consideration of inclusivity and accessibility

culture.description: Build experiences that people enjoy, share, and remember. This track focuses on creative technology, including games, interactive media, social platforms, and creator tools. The strongest projects are engaging, visually compelling, and built for real user interaction.
culture.challenge: How can you use technology to entertain, connect, or enable self-expression? Focus on building interactive experiences that people can immediately engage with and share.
whatGoodLooksLike: Highly interactive and engaging user experience
Strong visual or experiential design
Clear sense of fun, creativity, or emotional impact
Easy to demo and understand quickly
Something users would want to share or come back to

commerce.description: Build tools that help people and businesses create, manage, or move money more effectively. This track focuses on payments, budgeting, marketplaces, and financial decision-making. The strongest projects are practical, trustworthy, and solve real financial problems people face every day.
commerce.challenge: How can you use technology to help people earn, save, spend, or manage money better? Focus on building solutions that are simple, useful, and grounded in real-world financial needs.
whatGoodLooksLike: Solves a clear and practical financial problem
Simple and trustworthy user experience
Provides real value in saving time, money, or effort
Realistic use case for students, creators, or small businesses
Clear logic behind how money flows through the system

planet.description: Build technology that helps people understand and respond to environmental challenges. This track focuses on sustainability, climate, energy, and resource usage. The strongest projects make environmental data actionable, helping individuals or communities make better decisions.
planet.challenge: How can you use technology to promote sustainability or help people make more environmentally responsible decisions? Focus on solutions that turn data or awareness into real-world action.
whatGoodLooksLike: Addresses a clear environmental or sustainability problem
Goes beyond awareness to enable action or behavior change
Uses data in a meaningful and understandable way
Relevant to real communities, campuses, or everyday life
Simple, clear, and easy to demonstrate impact

beyond_reality.description: Build something that feels like the future. This track is for experimental, unconventional, and boundary-pushing ideas, blending AI, immersive experiences, simulations, and new ways of interacting with technology. The goal is to explore what’s possible and create something people won’t forget.
beyond_reality.challenge: What does the future look like, and how can you build a piece of it today? Create something bold, unconventional, or unexpected that reimagines how people interact with technology.
whatGoodLooksLike: Highly creative and unconventional concept
Pushes beyond traditional apps or websites
Strong “wow factor” or memorable experience
Interactive, immersive, or experimental design
Clear vision, even if the idea is ambitious
